summary.en: A leading AI model provider with multimodal capabilities, including text, speech, music and intelligent agent tools.
summary.zh: 领先的AI模型提供商，具备文本、语音、音乐和智能体工具等多模态能力。

title.en: MiniMax AI API Key - Multimodal AI Models | Get Model Key
title.zh: MiniMax AI API Key - 多模态AI模型 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get MiniMax AI API key for access to their full suite of multimodal AI models including text, speech, music and agent tools.
description.zh: 获取MiniMax AI API Key，访问其全系列多模态AI模型，包括文本、语音、音乐和智能体工具。

benefit.en: New users can generally claim about CNY 15 in trial credit, often with real-name verification required (subject to official policy).
benefit.zh: 新用户一般可领取约 15 元试用额度，通常需实名（具体以官方规则为准）。

notes.en: Its concise output style helps control token cost and works well for lightweight daily tasks plus multi-step command chaining in OpenClaw.
notes.zh: 输出风格精炼、Token 开销可控，适合 OpenClaw 的日常轻任务与多轮指令串联。

en: MiniMax is a China multimodal AI platform covering text LLMs, speech, music, video (Hailuo), and agent-oriented tools.
API access is managed in the MiniMax open platform; interface keys live under the user-center key page.
zh: MiniMax 是中国多模态 AI 平台，覆盖文本大模型、语音、音乐、视频（海螺）与智能体相关能力。
API 在 MiniMax 开放平台管理；接口密钥位于用户中心的 interface-key 页面。

en: Register or sign in at platform.minimaxi.com.
Open User Center → basic information → interface-key (official key page).
Create an interface key and copy it into a secure server-side secret store.
Read https://platform.minimaxi.com/docs/guides/models-intro for model IDs and calling conventions.
zh: 在 platform.minimaxi.com 注册或登录。
进入用户中心 → 基本信息 → interface-key（官方密钥页）。
创建接口密钥，并保存到安全的服务端密钥存储。
阅读 https://platform.minimaxi.com/docs/guides/models-intro 确认模型 ID 与调用方式。

answer.en: Text, speech, music, video/agent-related models appear in its catalog—confirm the live list in official docs.
answer.zh: 文本、语音、音乐、视频/智能体等相关模型都在其产品线中，具体以官方文档实时目录为准。

answer.en: Promotions vary and may require real-name verification. Rely on the official platform rules, not third-party claims.
answer.zh: 活动会变化，且可能需实名。请以官方平台规则为准，勿轻信第三方承诺。
